stem:
Avery and Mason are both swimming laps in the same swimming pool.

• Avery can swim 3 laps in 2 minutes.
• Mason can swim 5 laps in 4 minutes.

Based on these rates, which statement is NOT true?

options.label: F
options.text: Avery can swim 6 laps in 4 minutes.

options.label: G
options.text: Mason can swim 2.5 laps in 2 minutes.

options.label: H
options.text: Avery can swim 2 laps farther than Mason in 8 minutes.

options.label: J
options.text: Mason can swim 0.5 lap farther than Avery in 2 minutes.
